ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #16
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is √64? (1 mark)
   A. 64
   B. 9
   C. 32
   D. 8

2. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23.6
   B. 23.7
   C. 23
   D. 29

3. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 15.6
   C. 15
   D. 15.7

4. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. They are equal
   B. 1/4
   C. 2/2
   D. Cannot tell

5. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 31.6
   C. 31
   D. 31.7

6. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 16
   B. 22
   C. 55
   D. 32

7. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 25

8. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 38
   B. 88
   C. 19
   D. 22

9. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 120
   B. 30
   C. 46
   D. 23

10. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x
   B. 6x + 2
   C. 12x + 2
   D. 12x

11. What is √49? (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 49
   C. 7
   D. 24.5

12. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 37
   C. 1
   D. 1

13. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 43
   D. 1

14. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. They are equal
   B. 1/4
   C. Cannot tell
   D. 1/2

15. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 20
   C. 75
   D. 30

16. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27
   B. 27.6
   C. 33
   D. 27.7

17. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 31
   C. 1
   D. 2

18. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19
   B. 19.6
   C. 25
   D. 19.7

19. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 49
   D. 1

20. What is √36? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 6
   C. 36
   D. 18

21. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 6 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 90
   B. 42
   C. 21
   D. 30

22. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 6 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 17
   C. 34
   D. 66

23. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 122
   B. 22
   C. 121
   D. 11

24. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 144
   C. 48
   D. 156

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
